description: List the districts, counties or departments of a state. Deep adds population and its reporting period to each result on paid plans.

code.description: State code or name, e.g. NC, colorado

country.description: ISO2, ISO3, or a country name. Optional when the lookup is unique.

deep.description: Include population and its reporting period in each district detail bag on a paid plan.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

name: state_districts
